title: Claude 60-Second Setup
snippet:
*Grain MCP supports easy setup as a native [Claude Integration](https://www.anthropic.com/news/integrations).*
**Step 1: Integration Setup**
1. Navigate to **Settings** → **Integrations (Pro/Max Users)** → **Organization Settings (Team/Enterprise Users)**
![Screenshot 2025-06-16 at 3.14.59 PM.png](https://media.grain.com/public/developer-docs/Screenshot_2025-06-16_at_3.14.59_PM.png)
1. Click **"+ Add Integration"**
![Screenshot 2025-06-16 at 3.14.00 PM.png](https://media.grain.com/public/developer-docs/Screenshot_2025-06-16_at_3.14.00_PM.png)
1. Enter details and click the "**Add**" button:
- Integration Name: **Grain**
- Integration URL: **[https://api.grain.com/_/mcp](https://api.grain.com/_/mcp)**
![Screenshot 2025-06-16 at 3.12.05 PM.png](https://media.grain.com/public/developer-docs/Screenshot_2025-06-16_at_3.12.05_PM.png)
**Step 2: Connection / Authentication**
From **Settings** → **Integrations:**
1. Look for "Grain" in the list of integrations and click "Connect"
![Screenshot 2025-06-16 at 2.55.12 PM.png](https://media.grain.com/public/developer-docs/Screenshot_2025-06-16_at_2.55.12_PM.png)
1. Once automatically redirected to Grain, click "**Approve**"

From a New Claude chat:
1. Click "Search and Tools" and confirm you can see "Grain" in the list
![Screenshot 2025-06-16 at 2.56.06 PM.png](https://media.grain.com/public/developer-docs/Screenshot_2025-06-16_at_2.56.06_PM.png)
1. Click "Grain" to confirm the MCP tools are active, toggle tools on/off as desired

1. Test Connection by typing `"Tell me about my most recent Grain meeting"` or any other test prompt and Submit the chat

If everything is set up properly, you'll see Claude make requests to the available Grain tools that are needed to fulfill the data needs of the Chat request. For best results, turn off non-Grain tools that may distract or confuse the LLM or cite the name and filters of the Grain tool you want it to use from the [Available MCP Tools](tools-and-usage.html#available-mcp-tools) section.
## Claude Free Users & Other Clients (Developers Only)
**Cursor**
Click [Here](https://www.cursor.com/install-mcp?name=Grain&config=eyJ1cmwiOiJodHRwczovL2FwaS5ncmFpbi5jb20vXy9tY3AifQ%3D%3D) to Install

- **Settings** → **Developer** → **Edit Config**

title: Official Grain MCP Server
snippet:
# Official Grain MCP Server
Announced:
June 18, 2025
‍
Grain's official MCP server is available now for all users! 🎉
‍
With Grain's new MCP server you can securely access your meetings, notes, transcripts, deals, & coaching scorecard data natively using Anthropic's new Claude Integrations (ChatGPT coming soon), or using `mcp-remote` in Cursor, Windsurf and other clients.
‍
In addition to being able to ask any prompt in Cluade with Grain data, the server includes built-in MCP Prompts to run one-click reports like:
- 📣 Weekly "Voice of the Customer" reports to track sentiment & requests
- 📊 Pipeline IQ analysis to identify high opportunity & at-risk deals
- 🌶️ SPICED/MEDDICC reports to deeply understand a deal across meetings
- 🗣️ Sales Skill Scorecards to eval and track our team's performance over time
Check the demo and [quick-start guide](https://developers.grain.com/mcp) to get set up in less than 60 seconds.
Best,
Mike
‍
### **60 Second Set-up Instructions**
‍
**Native Integration Details:**
- Integration Name: **Grain**‍
- Integration URL: [https://api.grain.com/_/mcp](https://api.grain.com/_/mcp)
‍
**Mangual Config via `mcp-remote`:**
`{ "grain": { "command": "npx", "args": ["-y", "mcp-remote", "https://api.grain.com/_/mcp"] } }`

title: Connect your agent | Grain docs
snippet:
Grain speaks the Model Context Protocol, so agent clients such as Claude Desktop, Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, Windsurf and Codex can run queries, list schemas, and describe tables against your own databases.
## Connect with one command
After installing Grain, run:
```
grain connect
```
Grain lists the agents it supports, marks the ones it found, and connects only the ones you pick. To connect without prompts, name them: `grain connect --agent claude-desktop --agent cursor`. `grain disconnect` removes Grain from your agents.
## Connect manually
[Install Grain](https://grain.tools/docs/install) first. Every client then runs the same command, on macOS, Linux, and Windows:
```
grain --stdio
```
That is the whole setup contract. Everything below is how to hand that one command to a particular client. `--stdio` takes no value.
The bridge attaches to the shared Grain service when it is available. If the service cannot be reached, it reports isolated mode; queries still work, but their sessions do not appear in the editor.
Claude Code, Codex, VS Code, Cursor and Windsurf pick up the PATH the installer set, so `grain` is enough. Claude Desktop does not read your shell’s PATH, so it gets the full path; see its section.
## Before you connect
1. **Have connections.** Install the [extension](https://grain.tools/docs/install) and add a connection profile, or supply profiles through `GRAIN_CONNECTIONS`, as described in Headless connections.
2. **Check that MCP is on.** MCP is on by default. If you turned it off, turn `grain.mcpEnabled` back on in the Grain settings panel, or set `"mcp": { "enabled": true }` in `~/.grain/daemon.json`. While MCP is off, the bridge refuses with a message instead of failing quietly.
3. **Leave [safe mode](https://grain.tools/docs/safe-mode) on** unless you intend agents to run mutating SQL.
## Clients that take a command
### Claude Code
```
claude mcp add grain -- grain --stdio
```
### Cursor
Settings → **MCP Servers** → **Add new MCP server**. Type `command`, name `grain`, command `grain --stdio`.
### Windsurf
Settings → **Cascade** → **MCP Servers** → **Add Server**, then paste the same JSON as Claude Desktop below into `~/.codeium/windsurf/mcp_config.json`.
### VS Code and Copilot
VS Code reads MCP servers from `.vscode/mcp.json` in the workspace, or from your user `mcp.json` via **MCP: Open User Configuration** in the command palette. Note the key is `servers`, not `mcpServers`:
